name: SaunaLife CL5G 4-Person Outdoor Cube Cabin Sauna with Full Glass Front & Led Lighting
description: SaunaLife CL5G Outdoor Cube Cabin Sauna – Spacious Luxury for Four Designed for ultimate relaxation, the Cube-Series CL5G Sauna features contoured seating and supportive arched backrests, ensuring comfort even during extended sessions. The satin-smooth thermo-aspen seating remains cool to the touch, enhancing your overall experience. An expansive glass front wall creates a bright, airy atmosphere with stunning outdoor views. Revive your well-being and rejuvenate your body and soul with the SaunaLife CL5G. Combining modern style and unparalleled relaxation, this sauna will exceed your expectations for ultimate comfort and indulgence. Key Features: Spacious 4-Person Capacity: Roomy enough for group relaxation or solo indulgence. Premium Thermo-Spruce Exterior: Stunning, durable wood designed to withstand outdoor conditions. Full Glass Front Wall: Expansive tempered glass for a modern aesthetic and panoramic outdoor views. Ergonomic Seating & Backrests: Contoured design ensures comfort during extended sessions. Shingled Roof for Durability: Protects against the elements while maintaining style. Interior Height: Over 6’2”, accommodating comfortable movement. Craftsmanship: Designed by SaunaLife and handcrafted in Northern Europe for unmatched quality.
